identity.title: An ALMA survey of sub-millimetre Galaxies in the Extended Chandra Deep Field South: the far-infrared properties of SMGs
identity.journal: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society

paper_type_evidence.quote: Using the precisely located 870 $\mu$m ALMA positions of 99 SMGs, together with 24$\mu$m and radio imaging of this field, we deblend the *Herschel* / SPIRE imaging of this region

targets.name: ALESS SMGs (99 ALMA-detected LESS sources in the ECDFS)

evidence.quote: an ALMA survey of the 126 sub-mm sources in the 0.5 $\times$ 0.5 degree Extended *Chandra* Deep Field South (ECDFS), taken from the “LESS” survey (cite: Weiss09)
an ALMA survey of the 126 sub-mm sources in the 0.5 $\times$ 0.5 degree Extended *Chandra* Deep Field South (ECDFS), taken from the “LESS” survey (cite: Weiss09)

question.value: What are the far-infrared properties (colours, luminosities, dust temperatures, dust and gas masses) of ALMA-located SMGs in the ECDFS, and what do they imply for cosmic star formation and H2 density?

evidence.quote: we use the far-infrared (70–870$\mu$m) and 1.4 GHz radio photometry together with new optical/mid-infrared-derived photometric redshifts from Simpson et al. (2013) to derive the far-infrared luminosities, characteristic dust temperatures, dust masses
The ALMA observations were carried out under program 2011.0.00294.S.
observations of 122 of the 126 LESS sources were obtained with ALMA in Cycle 0 at 345 GHz (Band 7)
The observations employed 12–15 antennae and were obtained between 2011 October and 2011 November
yielding a synthesised beam of $\sim$ 1.6$''\times$1.2$''$
typical noise levels of $\sigma$ = 0.4–0.5 mJy beam$^{-1}$
obtained between 2011 October and 2011 November in good conditions

provided.value: 250, 350, 500 um maps deblended for SMG fluxes

evidence.quote: observations covering ECDFS were taken as part of the *Herschel* Multi-tiered Extra-galactic Survey (HerMES) guaranteed time program
were taken as part of the PACS Evolutionary Probe (PEP) survey

provided.value: 24 um catalog used for positional priors

evidence.quote: *Spitzer* / MIPS 24 $\mu$m imaging is also available for the ECDFS as part of the Far-Infrared Deep Extra-galactic Legacy (FIDEL) survey.
The ECDFS was observed with the JVLA in D, C, B and A configurations in 2007 June to September

what.value: ALESS SMG catalog (99 main-catalog SMGs, S/N>3.5)

evidence.quote: From the ALMA maps, (cite: Hodge13) extract 99 SMGs with S / N$>$3.5 from the best maps

what.value: Photometric redshifts and stellar masses of ALESS SMGs

evidence.quote: Simpson et al. (2013) used the 16-band optical–mid-infrared photometric coverage of ECDFS to derive photometric redshifts for 77 of the 99 ALESS SMGs.

what.value: CO-derived H2 masses used to calibrate gas-to-dust ratio

evidence.quote: we exploit the CO-derived H$_{\rm 2}$ masses from (cite: Bothwell13) who derive $M_{\rm H2}$ = 3.6 $\pm$ 1.0 $\times$ 10$^{10}$ M$_{\odot}$
Phase and bandpass calibration was based on J0403$-$360, J0538$-$440 respectively and flux calibration performed on available planets at the time of observation.

what.value: ALMA observations, reduction and source catalog

evidence.quote: Details of the ALMA observations of the sub-millimeter sources from the ALMA LESS (ALESS) survey are described in (cite: Hodge13) (cite: Karim13).
Simpson et al. (2013) show that the redshift distribution of the 96 ALESS SMGs is centered at $z$ = 2.5 $\pm$ 0.2

what.value: Detection limit and upper-limit definitions for deblending

evidence.quote: Following (cite: Magnelli13), we define the 3-$\sigma$ detection limit when 68% of the distribution are recovered with a fractional error less than 30%.

unstated_but_needed: CASA version and calibration/imaging parameters (deferred to Hodge13)
Exact SED template library files and fit priors/redshift handling details
Grey-body fit details (fixed beta, wavelengths used) for individual T_d
Bootstrap details for composite SED and luminosity function
Choice of ALMA data products used (archive vs. published catalog)

analysis_steps.goal: Deblend SPIRE maps with positional priors

method.value: Monte Carlo deblending using 24um, radio and ALMA positions as priors; 1000 initial models, iterated until convergence; 350/500um priors require >2σ detection at the shorter band

evidence.quote: To deblend the SPIRE map we develop a Monte Carlo algorithm.

key_parameters.value: 1.5'' matching radius for prior catalog; thumbnail extent ±2.5×FWHM

evidence.quote: we extract a thumbnail which has an extent $\pm$ 2.5 $\times$ the FWHM of the beam at that wavelength.

fitting.value: chi^2 minimisation over random flux models

evidence.quote: We then convolve this image with the relevant SPIRE point spread function (PSF) and record the amplitude of the residuals and $\chi^2$.

validation.value: Simulated SPIRE maps recover input fluxes (ratio 0.96, 0.97, 1.17); comparison to XID gives ~10% agreement

evidence.quote: This suggests that the “XID” and our deblending produce consistent flux densities to $\mathrel{\raise 0.35ex\hbox{$\scriptstyle <$}\kern-0.6em\lower 0.40ex\hbox{{$\scriptstyle \sim$}}}$ 10% accuracy.

analysis_steps.goal: Fit SEDs for L_IR, T_d and dust mass

method.value: Fit library of 185 templates plus modified black-body to 24um–1.4GHz photometry at photometric redshift; integrate 8–1000 um for L_IR

evidence.quote: Using the best-fit dust SEDs, we calculate the infrared luminosity ($L_{\rm IR}$) by integrating the rest-frame SED between 8–1000$\mu$m (rest-frame).
for a dust mass absorption coefficient of $\kappa_{870\mu m}$ = 0.15 m$^2$ kg$^{-1}$
We fit these template SEDs to the 24 $\mu$m–1.4 GHz photometry of the composite SED using a $\chi^2$ minimisation

analysis_steps.goal: Derive H2 masses and cosmic density contributions

method.value: Apply gas-to-dust ratio to dust masses; luminosity functions via 1/Vmax; extrapolate to 1 mJy with counts

evidence.quote: For simplicity, in all of the following analysis, we therefore adopt a single gas-to-dust ratio of $\delta_{\rm GDR}$ = 90 $\pm$ 25.
Assuming the SMGs have a burst duration of 250 Myr, we calculate the duty cycle as a function of redshift
The data were processed with the Common Astronomy Software Application ( casa; (cite: McMullin07)).
using hyper-z with the spectral templates of (cite: Bruzual03)
The median infrared luminosity for the ALESS SMGs is $L_{\rm IR}$ = (3.0 $\pm$ 0.3) $\times$ 10$^{12}$ $L_{\odot}$
The median dust mass for all of the SMGs in our sample is $M_{\rm d}$ = (3.6 $\pm$ 0.3) $\times$ 10$^{8}$ M$_{\odot}$
this suggests a median H$_2$ mass of $M_{\rm H2}$ = (4.2 $\pm$ 0.4) $\times$ 10$^{10}$ M$_{\odot}$ for the ALESS SMGs.

results_numeric.quantity: Median photometric z of SPIRE-undetected SMGs

evidence.quote: with $z$ = 3.3 $\pm$ 0.5 (c.f. $z$ = 2.5 $\pm$ 0.2; Simpson et al. 2013; Fig. [6](#fig:Nz))
gas depletion time-scale of $M_{\rm H_2}$ / SFR$\sim$ 130 $\pm$ 15 Myr

findings_qualitative.value: ALESS SMGs have dust temperatures 3–5 K cooler than local galaxies at fixed L_IR

evidence.quote: for a fixed luminosity, ALESS SMGs have cooler dust temperatures ($\Delta T_{\rm d}$ = 3–5 K)

claims.hypothesis: SPIRE peak wavelength tracks SMG redshift
claims.experiment: Deblend SPIRE at ALMA positions and split by SED peak
claims.finding: Redder SEDs lie at higher redshift

evidence.quote: the dust SEDs of the ALESS SMGs which peak closest to 250, 350 and 500$\mu$m peak at $z$ = 2.3 $\pm$ 0.2, 2.5 $\pm$ 0.3 and 3.5 $\pm$ 0.5 respectively.

claims.hypothesis: SMGs contribute significantly to cosmic SFR density

evidence.quote: This shows that SMGs contribute $\sim$ 20% of the total star formation over the redshift range $z$ = 1–5.

limitations_admitted.value: Deblending requiring 250um detection for 350um priors may bias against 250um-faint sources

evidence.quote: which may bias against galaxies that are faint at 250-$\mu$m and peak at longer wavelengths.

referee_caveats_inferred: Photometric redshifts have large uncertainties that propagate to L_IR and T_d
Single gas-to-dust ratio calibrated on a small CO sample
Extrapolation to 1 mJy assumes same redshift distribution and scaling

evidence.quote: All of the ALMA, *Herschel*, VLA and *Spitzer* data employed in this analysis are available through the ESO, Herschel VLA and *Spitzer* archives.

missing_for_reproduction: Deblending code not released; template library mentioned at URL only
reproducibility.score_reason: ALMA only supplies positions via an inherited catalog; main analysis uses Herschel data and templates with partial detail.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: ALMA role is minor and the key inputs (catalog, photo-z) come from companion papers.

methods_papers.why: detection limit definitions and PACS catalogs
